Subject (in full) Football Clubs, Students' Unions, etc. which are reputed to contain radical elements or have leanings towards communism.

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by （签名：Robertson Supt）

（左侧边栏手写：attached to D4238 /）

With reference to the instructions of the Officer i/c Special Branch dated January 1, 1933, attached.

In this connection, I have to report that the data supplied in connection with the abovementioned subject has proved of little or no value.

A general review of the subject has been made and has resulted in the following organizations, etc. being listed as the most likely to contain "red" or radical elements :-

1. Postal Workers' Club, No.230 Range Road.

2. Pootung B.A.Y. Workers' Union - now known as the 5th District Tobacco Factory Workers' Union, No.78 Lan Wyi Doo (澜威渡), Pootung.

3. Nantao Tramway Workers' Union, known as the 1st District Water & Electricity Workers' Union, No.231 Kuo Hu Road (国货路), Nantao.

4. The Great China University, Chung San Road, Western District.

5. Chinan University, Chenju.

6. Nanyang Brothers Workers, various internal organizations.

7. Futan University, Kiangwan.

Although present conditions in these organizations and institutions may be defined as normal, it only requires some minor incident or so-called patriotic movement to give their radical members grounds for renewing their activities.

In addition to the foregoing, troublesome elements are to be found among ex-workers of the [模糊不清] ... and the Sun Yue Pearl Factory.

Sir,

With reference to D.O. "D"'s Memo, I beg to report as far
as can be ascertained no football or sports club, boyscout
organizations, student unions etc. have any "red" or radical
leanings in this district.

The only possible place where meetings are likely to be
held is at the rear of the B.C.C. Factory, Kwenming & Whashing
Roads corner, where it has been rumoured that communists have
planned to play football with the factory workers. This place
is being kept under observation.
